column1: # MIGRATION_PROXIES.tsv — sub-annual FL migration proxy legs (built by DAEDALUS 2026-07-10, Will-approved Tier-3 gap #6)
# FRAMING RULE: Proxies are DIRECTION/DERIVATIVE tells for VX-MARCO-3.03 between annual Census prints — they NEVER
#   restate the canonical level (different bases: registered voters / licensed drivers / K-12 families ≠ total
#   population; vintage/basis traps are the fleet's worst error class). Canonical: FL net domestic migration
#   +22,517 (2025, Census) — workbook/VX.tsv VX-MARCO-3.03; next print ~Dec 2026.
# LEGS: FLHSMV_LICENSE_INFLOW (quarterly, MANUAL from free MIAMI-Realtors publications ~Jan/Apr/Jul/Oct — FLHSMV
#   raw data not free) · VOTER_REG_NET (monthly, SCRIPT: tools/fl_migration_proxies.py, FL DOS "New and Removed
#   Voters by County") · FLDOE_ENROLLMENT (2x/school-yr, MANUAL: Survey 2 ~Dec-Jan, Survey 3 ~Feb-Mar) ·
#   OCPS_HEADCOUNT / OCPS_COHORT_ATTRITION (added 2026-09-17, MANUAL, 2x/school-yr: OCPS enrollment_summary_09_15_YY
#   and _05_15_YY PDFs; Orange County ONLY). ⛔ ENROLLMENT IS A BOUND, NOT A DIRECTION TELL: a public-school count
#   cannot separate out-migration from voucher/private/homeschool substitution (CORAL 9/13, district's own cause list);
#   the within-cohort attrition term is the UPPER BOUND on migration-consistent loss. Full decomposition: KB-MARCO-FLM-37.
# USPS COA excluded by design: paywalled since 2023, not free.
# PERIOD CONVENTIONS: YYYY-MM (monthly) · YYYY-Qn · YYYY-Hn · FLDOE uses YYYY-10 (Survey 2 Oct count) /
#   YYYY-02 (Survey 3 Feb count). value = level where the source gives one, else NA (direction still usable).
# VOTER_REG_NET CAVEAT: removals are dominated by list-maintenance purge cycles (e.g. Mar-Jun 2025: 31K/39K/32K/14K
#   inactive removals), so net swings on purges, not migration — yoy_pct is computed on NEW valid voters (inflow),
#   the cleaner direction read.
